summary: Overdue hiker on Kelso Ridge/Torreys Peak, days 1-3; recovery day 4 on 7/18 (2019-68 to 2019-71)
notes: ART missions 2019-68 (7/16, day 1), 2019-69 (7/17, day 2), 2019-70 (7/18, day 3), 2019-71 (7/18, day 4 recovery, asterisk). Subject found deceased. Merged CSAR narratives (run 84): subject was the father of Brian Chambliss, an experienced climber (Aconcagua, Denali, Cho Oyu summits), missing on Kelso Ridge, Torreys Peak; ~20 Alpine volunteers + Flight for Life + National Guard helicopter searched ~4 days; body found after a ~20-story fall from the ridge, died on impact; Colorado Division of Fire Prevention and Control helicopter assisted the recovery.
